recipe_note: QFFT official yaml (LLaMA-Factory examples/train_qfft/train_s1_qfft.yaml): full FT, LR 1e-5, 6 epochs, cosine, warmup_ratio 0.1, wd 1e-4, default AdamW betas (0.9, 0.999), 16K cutoff with truncation, batch 8 (8 GPUs, ZeRO-3 offload). v93 keeps every optimizer setting and changes two things: batch 16 (as s1.1-7B) to halve CPU-Adam steps, and a 32K window without truncation so all 1000 traces end with their answer.
